links.comparator_used: Unmodified AI auto-segmentation (also compared with fully manual delineation by junior radiation oncology residents)
links.outcome: CTV contouring accuracy (HD, MDA, DSC) against senior oncologist ground truth, plus inter-observer variability for OARs
links.effect: CTV median HD, MDA and DSC values of 20.03 vs. 21.55 mm, 2.57 vs. 3.06 mm, 0.745 vs. 0.703 (all P<0.05); OAR results were similar; CV for OARs reduced by approximately 50%
links.quote: AI-assisted delineation achieved significantly higher accuracy compared to unmodified AI auto-contouring and fully manual delineation by radiation oncologists, with median HD, MDA, and DCS values of 20.03 vs. 21.55 mm, 2.57 vs. 3.06 mm, 0.745 vs. 0.703 (all P<0.05) for CTV, respectively.

design_hint: clinician review and modification of AI outputs
